sources.title: Zero-Shot vs One-Shot vs Few-Shot Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: In artificial intelligence (AI), zero-shot and few-shot learning are groundbreaking concepts that have significantly advanced the capabilities of machine learning models. These techniques enable models to recognize and classify new data with little or no training examples, making them incredibly versatile and efficient. sources.title: Zero-Shot Transfer: Definition & AI Applications
sources.snippet: Zero-Shot Transfer Zero-shot transfer is the capability of a pre-trained AI model to perform a novel task without any task-specific training data, typically by interpreting natural language instructions or prompts.
